# NaturalDomainRepresentations

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A method of encoding domain-specific knowledge directly into the representation space of a concept extraction model, rather than relying on generic text embeddings. Enables TCC/iNEST systems to extract and reason about topology and neuromorphic concepts with higher fidelity by aligning representations with domain structure.
